legendaryActions.description: The heirophant lich uses its Unholy Smite.

legendaryActions.name: Damnation
legendaryActions.description: The hierophant lich threatens one creature within 10 feet of it with eternal suffering. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the hierophant lich's Damnation for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ray of Frost
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage  and the targets Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the nobles next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The priest is an 11th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15 +7 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy
- 1st-Level (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Healing Word
- 2nd-Level (3 slots): Augury, Hold Person, Zone of Truth
- 3rd-Level (3 slots): Daylight, Remove Curse
- 4th-Level (3 slots): Divination, Guardian of Faith, Revivify
- 5th-Level (2 slots): Flame Strike, Greater Restoration, Raise Dead
- 6th-Level (1 slots): Heal

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.description: (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) One humanoid the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Guardian of Faith
actions.description: (4th-Level; V) A Large  indistinct spectral guardian appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet and remains for 8 hours. Creatures of the priests choice that move to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 20 radiant or necrotic damage (high priests choice) on a failed save or half damage on a success. The spell ends when the guardian has dealt 60 total damage.

actions.name: Flame Strike
actions.description: (5th-Level; V, S, M) A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word
bonusActions.description: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 6 (1d4 + 4) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.description: The pugilists AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pugilist attacks three times with their fists.

actions.name: Fists
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the pugilist can't grapple a different target.

actions.name: Pin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Haymaker
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

bonusActions.name: Head Shot
bonusActions.description: The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the pugilists next turn.

reactions.name: Opportune Jab
reactions.description: If a creature attempts to grapple the pugilist, the pugilist attacks that creature with their fists.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant attacks twice with its greatclub.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. In lieu of a rock  the giant can throw a grappled Medium or smaller creature up to 30 feet. On a hit  the target and the thrown creature both take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

actions.name: Greatclub Sweep
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage  is pushed 10 feet away from the giant  and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the giant can't grab another target, and it makes greatclub attacks with advantage against the grappled target.

traits.name: Giant Attributes
traits.description: The hill giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

traits.name: Show of Might
traits.description: The hill giant can use STR instead of CHA when making CHA (Intimidation) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Spiked Tree Branch or Rotten Snack attacks.

actions.name: Spiked Tree Branch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rotten Snack
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Body Bounce
bonusActions.description: The hill giant bumps its stomach, hip, shoulder, knee, or other part of its body into a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.description: The giant makes Insight checks with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant attacks twice with its greatclub.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. In lieu of a rock  the giant can throw a grappled Medium or smaller creature up to 30 feet. On a hit  the target and the thrown creature both take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a miss  only the thrown creature takes the damage. The thrown creature falls prone in an unoccupied space 5 feet from the target.

actions.name: Greatclub Sweep
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage  is pushed 10 feet away from the giant  and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the giant can't grab another target, and it makes greatclub attacks with advantage against the grappled target.

bonusActions.name: Body Slam
bonusActions.description: The giant jumps up to 15 feet horizontally without provoking opportunity attacks and falls prone in a space containing one or more creatures. Each creature in its space when it lands makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure. On a success, the creature takes half damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of its choice. If that space is occupied, the creature falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Muddy Ground
bonusActions.description: Areas of unworked earth within 60 feet magically become swampy mud for 1 minute or until the giant dies. These areas become difficult terrain. Prone creatures in the area when the mud appears or that fall prone in the area make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creatures Speed drops to 0 as it becomes stuck in the mud. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Strength check, freeing itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Stomp
bonusActions.description: The giant stamps its foot, causing the ground to tremble. Each creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it falls prone.

traits.name: Aura of Misfortune
traits.description: Creatures within 15 ft. of it treat attack rolls of 20 as 19 and can’t gain advantage on ability checks attacks and saves.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While hinderling curse remains on a victim a slain hinderling returns to life in 1 day regaining all its hp and becoming active again. Hinderling appears within 100' of victim.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Run and Hide
reactions.description: When a creature hinderling can see targets it with weapon hinderling chooses another creature within 5 ft. as attack's target then moves up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

display.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The hinn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the hinn doesn't disturb the material through which it moves.

traits.name: Nebulous (Cloud Form Only)
traits.description: The hinn's Stealth is 20, it can hover while flying, can't manipulate objects or attack, and it can pass through any space air can pass through without squeezing. In addition, it can enter and hide in any Tiny or larger container, such as a pouch, lamp, backpack, or barrel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hinn makes three Gem-Studded Mace or Lob Stone attacks. If two Gem-Studded Mace attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gem-Studded Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6+6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lob Stone
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Create Earth Elemental
actions.description: The hinn magically creates one earth-based Elemental of CR 5 or lower in an unoccupied space the hinn can see within 30 feet of it. The elemental acts as an ally of the hinn, obeying its spoken commands. The elemental remains for 1 hour, until the hinn dies, or until the hinn dismisses it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Travel the Planes
actions.description: The hinn transports itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except it can affect only itself and can't use this action to banish an unwilling creature.

bonusActions.name: Churned Earth
bonusActions.description: The hinn causes the ground on a point it can see within 60 feet of it to erupt. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Genie Shape
bonusActions.description: The hinn magically transforms into a Medium cloud of dust filled with miniscule clashing, bursting, and reforming rocks or back into its bipedal form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its bipedal form if it dies. The hinn can't use this bonus action to transform into its bipedal form while inside a Medium or smaller container.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hippocampus can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shared Breath
traits.description: The hippocampus's gills pull more air from the water than the hippocampus needs, expelling the excess as bubbles down its neck and across its back. If an air-breathing creature is riding the hippocampus, these bubbles can provide that creature a supply of fresh air when the hippocampus isn't in combat or traveling at a fast pace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippocampus makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Rearing Kick
bonusActions.description: The hippocampus rears up and kicks its forelegs at one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet away from the hippocampus (the hippocampus's choice).

display.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

display.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Heightened Sight
traits.description: The hippogriff's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The hippogriff is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hippogriff makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Dive
bonusActions.description: While flying, the hippogriff dives onto a creature below it. The hippogriff moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature it can see. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: Knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Divine Jaws
traits.description: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with Gore Gore deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included) hippo’s choice.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Sacred Guardian
traits.description: Can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward its sacred site within 120' of itself. In addition it can sense when such a creature moves within 100' of the site and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

bonusActions.name: Protector's Step
bonusActions.description: Magically teleports with any items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30' of exterior of its site. Golden light swirls or inky shadown tendrils (hippo's choice) appear at origin and destination.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find or track a creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

bonusActions.name: Hidden Predator
bonusActions.description: Takes the Hide action.

display.speed: 25 ft., Climb 12 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 12 ft.

traits.name: Collective Mind
traits.description: The hivebound's individual insects and swarms under its control are connected via a hive mind. It can telepathically communicate with any of its individual insects and swarms within 1 mile of it, and it can't be surprised. It can have up to five swarms of insects under its control at a time.

traits.name: Monstrosity Resilience
traits.description: The hivebound is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

traits.name: Reinforced Mind
traits.description: If the hivebound starts its turn afflicted by an ongoing effect that allows a repeated INT, WIS, or CHA save to end the effect, such as the hold spell, the hivebound can make the save at the start of the turn instead of the end and has advantage on the save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hivebound makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Spit Insect attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Insect
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or be pestered until the end of its next turn. A pestered creature has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the pester ends.

actions.name: Swarm Breath
actions.description: The hivebound exhales stinging insects in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 10 (4d4) piercing damage and 17 (5d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A swarm of insects under the hivebound's control then forms in an unoccupied space in that area.

bonusActions.name: Swift Flight
bonusActions.description: The hivebound flies up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Miser’s Fury
traits.description: The hoard drake knows the scent of every coin, gem and item of value in its hoard. The drake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception and Survival) checks to find and track its hoard. In addition, it has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature is in possession of any portion of its hoard.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: A hoard drake can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and minerals, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it. In addition, it can differentiate between various types of metals and minerals and can determine if the metal or mineral is magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hoard drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Midas Breath
actions.description:
The hoard drake spits molten gold in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and the gold clings to it. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and the gold doesn't cling to it. A creature with gold clinging to it has its speed halved until it takes an action to scrape off the gold.

The gold produced by Midas Breath can be collected once it has cooled, providing roughly 50 gp worth of gold dust and scraps each time it spits molten gold.

display.languages: understands the language of its creator but can't speak
display.damageImmunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
display.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhausted, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Strike with Awe
traits.description: Creatures within 120 feet of an immobile hoard golem suffer disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. A creature's sheer glee on discovering a vast hoard of treasure distracts it from its surroundings.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (6d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Thieving Whirlwind
actions.description: The hoard golem transforms into a 20-foot radius whirlwind of the treasures of which it is composed. In this form, it has immunity to all slashing and piercing damage. As a whirlwind, it can enter other creatures' spaces and stop there. Every creature in a space the whirlwind occupies must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 40 (6d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the whirlwind removes the most valuable visible item on the target, including wielded items, but not armor. If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and retains all possessions. The golem can remain in whirlwind form for up to 3 rounds, or it can transform back to its normal form on any of its turns as a bonus action.

display.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
display.damageImmunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
display.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The golem doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Enchanted Weapons
traits.description: The golem’s weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 force damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Strike with Awe
traits.description: A creature that enters a space within 120 feet of the hoard golem or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while it remains within 120 feet of the golem.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hoard golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

actions.name: Thieving Whirlwind
actions.description: The hoard golem partially disperses into a whirlwind of coins, gemstones, and other valuables then recoalesces. Each creature within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage and loses one object it is wearing or carrying. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't lose an object. Each object the golem steals must weigh no more than 20 pounds and not be wrapped around or firmly attached to a creature. For example, the golem could steal a belt pouch full of coins or a creature's jewel-encrusted dagger, but it can't steal a creature's shirt or armor. The hoard golem steals objects of high value over those of minimal value. The stolen object becomes part of the golem's body and can't be retrieved until the golem dies.

display.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The hoarfrost drake can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Icy Scales
traits.description: The hoarfrost drake has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hoarfrost drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cloud of Riming Ice
actions.description:
The hoarfrost drake creates a cloud of freezing fog that rimes everything in frost. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) cold damage and must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or drop whatever it's holding. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't drop what it's holding.

The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of the hoarfrost drake's next turn. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

reactions.name: Retaliatory Slip
reactions.description: When a creature grapples the drake, the drake can immediately attempt to escape. If it succeeds, it can make a bite attack against the creature that grappled it.

traits.name: Formation Movement
traits.description: If the hobgoblin begins its turn within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated, its movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage  or 10 (2d8 + 1) slashing damage if within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10+1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Tactical Analysis
bonusActions.description: The hobgoblin briefly studies one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. It has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that creature before the start of the hobgoblin's next turn.

traits.name: Formation Movement
traits.description: If the hobgoblin begins its turn within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated, its movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin attacks twice with its greatsword.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Officers Command
actions.description: The hobgoblin inspires creatures of its choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand it and that have a Challenge Rating of 2 or lower. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Officers Command at a time.

traits.name: Unshakable Command
traits.description: Each friendly creature within 30 feet of the hobgoblin commander can't be charmed or frightened while the commander isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin commander makes three Greatsword or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Martial Tactics
bonusActions.description:
The hobgoblin commander employs one of the following tactics:
- Emboldening Shout. One friendly creature within 30 feet of the hobgoblin commander that it can see gains 7 (2d6) temporary HP until the start of the commander's next turn.
- Pressing Advance. The commander moves up to half its speed and commands one friendly creature it can see within 30 feet of it to also move. The target can use its reaction to move up to half its speed in the direction of the commander's choosing. This movement for both creatures is unaffected by difficult terrain and doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Bloodied Rage
traits.description: While bloodied, the warlord can attack four times with its greatsword or twice with its javelin when it uses Multiattack but no longer gains the benefit of its Military Training trait.

traits.name: Elite Recovery
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, while bloodied, the hobgoblin can end one condition or effect on itself. It can do this even when unconscious or incapacitated.

traits.name: Formation Movement
traits.description: If the hobgoblin begins its turn within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated, its movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Military Training
traits.description: The hobgoblin has advantage on ability checks to make a tactical, strategic, or political decision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hobgoblin attacks twice with its greatsword.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Officers Command
actions.description: The hobgoblin inspires creatures of its choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand it and that have a Challenge Rating of 2 or lower. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Officers Command at a time.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the hodag moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.description: The hodag’s teeth, claws, horns, and tail spikes are extra sharp. These weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The hodag has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hodag makes three melee attacks, but can use its bite and horn attacks only once each.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Territorial Display
actions.description: The hodag rears and stomps on the ground then roars a territorial challenge. Each creature within 10 feet of the hodag must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also knocked prone.

display.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The holler spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.description: If the holler spider remains motionless for at least 1 minute, it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hoot
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) thunder damage. If the holler spider scores a critical hit, it is pushed 5 feet away from the target.

actions.name: Distressed Discharge
actions.description: The holler spider releases a short, distressed cacophony in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The holler spider is pushed 15 feet in the opposite direction of the cone.

reactions.name: Sound Alarm
reactions.description: When the holler spider detects a creature within 60 feet of it, the spider can emit a hoot or trumpet audible within 300 feet of it. The noise continues until the creature moves out of range, the spider's handler uses an action to soothe it, or the spider ends the alarm (no action required).

traits.name: Aura of Courage
traits.description: While the knight is conscious, allies within 10 feet are immune to being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight attacks twice with their greatsword.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage. If the knight moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  they deal an extra 13 (2d12) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. This attack is made at disadvantage against targets within 5 feet.

actions.name: Lay On Hands
actions.description: The knight touches a willing creature or themself and restores 30 hit points.

actions.name: Knightly Inspiration
actions.description: The knight inspires creatures of their choice within 30 feet that can hear and understand them. For the next minute  inspired creatures gain an expertise die (1d4) on attack rolls and saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Knightly Inspiration at a time  and the knight cannot target themselves.

display.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 10 ft.
display.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.description: While they are on the same plane, the homunculus and its creator can communicate telepathically at any distance.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned. At the end of its next turn  it repeats the saving throw. On a success  the effect ends. On a failure  it falls unconscious for 1 minute. If it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it awake  it wakes up  and the poisoned effect ends.

display.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 10 ft.
display.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Bound Construct
traits.description: The homunculus serves another creature as a familiar, forming a magic, telepathic bond with that willing companion. While the two are bonded and on the same plane of existence, the companion can sense what the homunculus senses and the two can communicate telepathically. While the homunculus is within 100 feet of the companion, it can use a reaction to deliver any spell the companion casts that has a range of touch. If the spell requires an attack roll, the homunculus uses the companion's spell attack modifier for the roll. While the homunculus is within 10 feet of its companion, the companion has advantage on INT (Arcana) and INT (Investigation) checks. At any time and for any reason, the homunculus can end its service as a familiar, ending the telepathic bond.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The homunculus doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.description: The homunculus is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

display.damageResistances: lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
display.conditionImmunities: blinded, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Exacerbate Affliction
traits.description: The hongaek has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that is suffering from a disease or that has the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Gas Form
traits.description: The hongaek can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, but it can’t move through water or other liquids.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
traits.description: The hongaek can innately cast contagion, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

traits.name: Prolong Affliction
traits.description: Each creature within 30 feet of the hongaek that is suffering a disease or that has the poisoned condition has disadvantage on saving throws against the disease or poison afflicting it. In addition, the hongaek can pinpoint the location of such creatures within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hongaek makes two attacks with its vaporous tentacles.

actions.name: Vaporous Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The hongaek magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the hongaek wears or carries is invisible with it.

display.languages: the languages spoken in the village where it was created

traits.name: Harvest Life
traits.description: When the hooden horse reduces a creature to 0 hp, the hooden horse regains 10 (3d6) hp.

traits.name: Seek Wrongdoer
traits.description: The hooden horse automatically knows the general direction to the nearest surviving perpetrator of the crime that provoked its creation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hooden horse makes two blade of retribution attacks.

actions.name: Blade of Retribution
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) necrotic damage. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is a perpetrator of the crime that provoked the hooden horse's creation, it has disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Call to Judgment
actions.description:
The hooden horse points at a being it can see and demands that the creature submit to justice. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the hooden horse, the target must take the Dash action on its turn to move toward the hooden horse by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but, before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, the target can repeat the saving throw. The creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns or whenever it takes damage from the hooden horse. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.

The hooden horse can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

display.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: A horakh can hide as a bonus action if it's in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: As part of its movement, the horakh can jump up to 20 feet horizontally and 10 feet vertically, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horakh makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the bite attack hits a target that's grappled by the horakh, the target must make a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or one of its eyes is bitten out. A creature with just one remaining eye has disadvantage on ranged attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. If both (or all) eyes are lost, the target is blinded. The regenerate spell and comparable magic can restore lost eyes. Also see Implant Egg, below.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. If both attacks hit the same Medium or smaller target in a single turn, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Implant Egg
actions.description: If a horakh's bite attack reduces a grappled creature to 0 hit points, or it bites a target that's already at 0 hit points, it implants an egg in the creature's eye socket. The deposited egg grows for 2 weeks before hatching. If the implanted victim is still alive, it loses 1d2 Constitution every 24 hours and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. After the first week, the victim is incapacitated and blinded. When the egg hatches after 2 weeks, an immature horakh erupts from the victim's head, causing 1d10 bludgeoning, 1d10 piercing, and 1d10 slashing damage. A lesser restoration spell can kill the egg during its incubation.

display.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Implant Egg
traits.description: If the horakh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a Bite attack or as a bonus action while within 5 feet of a creature with 0 hp, the horakh can implant an egg in the creature. The implanted egg rests in the creature’s eye socket for 14 days while it incubates. A host creature can carry only one horakh egg to term at a time. While the egg is implanted, the host can’t use its eye and has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Exactly 24 hours before the egg hatches, the host becomes blinded. When the egg hatches, the young horakh erupts from the host’s head, killing the host in the process.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The horakh’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horakh makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the horakh scores a critical hit, it removes one of the target's eyes, provided the target has eyes, and places the eye in a fluid sac on its thorax. While missing half or less of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is blinded until its sight is restored.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.description: While in dim light or darkness, the horakh takes the Hide action.

traits.name: 1 Bat Head
traits.description: The demon emits a 15-foot cone of cacophonous sound. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) thunder damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

traits.name: 10 Whispering Mouth
traits.description: The demon targets a creature within 30 feet that can hear it. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 7 (1d8 + 3) psychic damage and is magically cursed until the start of the demons next turn. While cursed, the demons attacks against the target are made with advantage, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the demons Whispering Mouth.

traits.name: 2 Bulging Eyes (Gaze)
traits.description: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: 3 Claws
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: 4 Fangs
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: 5 Goat Horns
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw, falling prone on a failure.

traits.name: 6 Lamprey Mouth
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the lamprey mouth attack can be used only on this target and automatically hits.

traits.name: 7 Porcupine Quills
traits.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: 8 Scorpion Tail Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft
traits.description: , one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

traits.name: 9 Tentacle Arms Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft
traits.description: , one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the tentacle arms attack can only be used on this target.

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.description: The demon radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Radiant Weakness
traits.description: If the demon takes radiant damage while it is bloodied, it is frightened for 1 minute.

traits.name: Varied Shapes
traits.description: Each horde demon has a unique combination of attacks and powers. Roll 1d10 once or twice, rerolling duplicates, or choose one or two features from the following table. A horde demons features determine the attacks it can make.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demon makes two attacks  using any attack granted by its Varied Shapes trait.

display.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Area Vulnerability
traits.description: The band takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

traits.name: Band
traits.description: The band is composed of 5 or more horde demons. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The band can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Band Dispersal
traits.description: When the band is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) horde demons with 26 hit points each.

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.description: The band radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The band attacks twice.

actions.name: Mob Attack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 50 (10d6 + 15) slashing damage  or half damage if the band is bloodied.

display.damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; damage from nonmagical weapons
display.conditionImmunities: charmed, fatigue, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The horde can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Area Vulnerability
traits.description: The horde takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

traits.name: Horde
traits.description: The horde is composed of 5 or more shadows. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects.

traits.name: Horde Dispersal
traits.description: When the horde is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) shadows, each of which are bloodied.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.description: While in sunlight, the horde has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The horde doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horde makes up to three claw attacks  but no more than one against each target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) necrotic damage  and the target makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target is cursed until it finishes a short or long rest or is the subject of remove curse or a similar spell. While cursed  the target makes attack rolls  Strength checks  and Strength saving throws with disadvantage. If the target dies while cursed  a new undead shadow rises from the corpse in 1d4 hours  the corpse no longer casts a natural shadow  and the target can't be raised from the dead until the new shadow is destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Sneak
bonusActions.description: The horde takes the Hide action even if obscured only by dim light or darkness.

display.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.
display.damageResistances: cold; damage from nonmagical, non-silvered weapons

traits.name: Devils Sight
traits.description: The devils darkvision penetrates magical darkness.

traits.name: Lawful Evil
traits.description: The devil radiates a Lawful and Evil aura.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two attacks with its fork and one with its tail. It can replace any melee attack with Hurl Flame.

actions.name: Fork
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or construct  it makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it receives an infernal wound and takes 11 (2d10) ongoing piercing damage. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack  the ongoing damage increases by 11 (2d10). A creature can spend an action to make a DC 12 Medicine check  ending the ongoing damage on a success. At least 1 hit point of magical healing also ends the ongoing damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is an unattended flammable object or a creature  it catches fire  taking 5 (1d10) ongoing fire damage. A creature can use an action to extinguish this fire.

actions.name: Inferno
actions.description: The devil waves its fork  igniting a trail of roaring flame. Any creature within 10 feet of the devil makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw  taking 49 (14d6) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

reactions.name: Pin
reactions.description: When a creature misses the devil with a melee attack, the devil makes a fork attack against that creature. On a hit, the target is impaled by the fork and grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the devil can't make fork attacks or use Inferno, but the target takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

display.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Devilish Resilience
traits.description: The devil is resistant to cold damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to fire damage and poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Fork attacks and one Tail attack, or it makes three Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Fork
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8+6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or lose 10 (3d6) HP at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 WIS (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (5d6+3) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

bonusActions.name: Headbutt
bonusActions.description: The horned devil slams its horned head into a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 STR save. On a failure, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The horned serpent can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Corpse Cough
traits.description: Those who fail a saving throw against the horned serpent's Gem Gaze or bite attack become infected with the corpse cough disease. The infected creature can't benefit from short or long rests due to a constant, wet cough. The infected creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw each day or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until the target is cured of the disease with a greater restoration spell or similar magic. If the infected creature comes into physical contact with a blood relative before the disease is cured, the relative must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or also become infected with the disease. The blood relative is afflicted with a constant, wet cough within hours of infection, but the disease's full effects don't manifest until 1d4 days later. Corpse cough is so named due to the smell of the cough as the infected creature's lungs become necrotic.

traits.name: Poisonous Aura
traits.description: At the start of each of the horned serpent's turns, each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.description: The horned serpent is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horned serpent makes one gore attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the corpse cough disease (see the Corpse Cough trait).

actions.name: Gem Gaze
actions.description: The horned serpent's gem flashes, bathing a 30-foot cone in iridescent light. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 (10d6) radiant damage and is infected with the corpse cough disease (see the Corpse Cough trait). On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't infected with the disease. Gem Gaze has no effect on constructs and undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur attacks with its pike and its hooves.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage  or 10 (2d6 + 3) damage if the centaur moved at least 30 feet towards the target before the attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this attack deals damage  the centaurs movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks from the target for the rest of the centaurs turn.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadeye Shot
actions.description: The centaur makes a shortbow attack with advantage.

traits.name: Draft Animal
traits.description: The draft horse can push, drag, or lift weight in pounds equal to three times its carrying capacity.

traits.name: Hraesvelgr's Lair
traits.description:
on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Hraesvelgr takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Hraesvelgr can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

- Hraesvelgr unleashes a blast of wind in a 60-foot cone. All creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

- One creature within 60 feet that Hraesvelgr can see must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be swept up in a pillar of wind. The creature is restrained and suspended 15 feet off the ground. If the creature has something to pull on, it can pull itself out of the wind by using an action and making a successful DC 15 Strength check; another creature who can reach the suspended creature can pull it free in the same way. Alternatively, a flying creature can repeat the saving throw as an action. On a success, it moves 5 feet out of the pillar of wind. This effect lasts until Hraesvelgr takes this action again or dies.

- Hraesvelgr lets out a thunderous bellow in giant form or an ear-splitting shriek in roc form. All creatures within 30 feet must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.description: If Hraesvelgr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regional Effects
traits.description:
the region containing Hraesvelgr's lair is warped by the corpse swallower's magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

- Strong windstorms are common within 6 miles of the lair.

- Giant avian beasts are drawn to the lair and fiercely defend it against intruders.

- The wind within 10 miles of the lair bears a pungent carrion stench.

if Hraesvelgr dies, conditions in the area surrounding the lair return to normal over the course of 1d10 days.

legendaryActions.name: Swallow
legendaryActions.description: Hraesvelgr makes a bite attack against a creature he has grappled. If he hits, he swallows the creature. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but is blinded, restrained, and has advantage against attacks and effects originating from outside Hraesvelgr. A swallowed creature takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. If Hraesvelgr returns to giant form, or takes 40 damage or more in a single turn from a swallowed creature, he must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land prone within 10 feet of the giant. If Hraesvelgr dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape the corpse by spending 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Calm State
traits.description: When a hulking whelp is calm and unafraid, it uses the following statistics instead of those listed above: Size Small; HP 9 (6d6 - 12); Speed 20 ft.; STR 8 (-1); CON 6 (-2); Languages Common, Sylvan

traits.name: Poor Senses
traits.description: A hulking whelp has poor hearing and is nearsighted. It can see in normal or dim light up to 30 feet and hear sounds from up to 60 feet away.

traits.name: Unleashed Emotion
traits.description: When a hulking whelp feels threatened - it's touched, intimidated, cornered, attacked, or even just if a stranger moves adjacent to the whelp - it immediately grows from size Small to Huge as a reaction. If the whelp was attacked, this reaction occurs after the attack is made but before damage is done. Nearby creatures and objects are pushed to the nearest available space and must make a successful DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone. Weapons, armor, and other objects worn or carried by the hulking whelp grow (and shrink again) proportionally when it changes size. Overcome by raw emotion, it sets about destroying anything and everything it can see (which isn't much) and reach (which is quite a lot). The transformation lasts until the hulking whelp is unaware of any nearby creatures for 1 round, it drops to 0 hit points, it has 5 levels of exhaustion, or it's affected by a calm emotions spell or comparable magic. The transformation isn't entirely uncontrollable; people or creatures the whelp knows and trusts can be near it without triggering the reaction. Under the wrong conditions, such as in a populated area, a hulking whelp's Unleashed Emotion can last for days.

traits.description: The husk demon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Demonic Resilience
traits.description: The husk demon is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The husk demon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The husk demon makes two Life Drain attacks.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the husk demon regains HP equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creatures finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

bonusActions.name: Soul Feed
bonusActions.description:
The husk demon feasts on the light in the soul of up to two creatures it can see within 20 feet of it, causing one of the following effects. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 CHA save or suffer the chosen effect. A creature that fails the save against Soul Feed two rounds in a row suffers one level of exhaustion.
- Happiness Feast. The husk demon feasts on the target's happiness, causing the target to become crestfallen. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
- Hope Feast. The husk demon feasts on the target's hope, causing the target to become despondent. The target has disadvantage on saves until the end of its next turn.
- Motivation Feast. The husk demon feasts on the target's motivation, causing the target to lose its ambitions and become apathetic. The target's speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

display.senses: blindsight 120 ft., darkvision 12017 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Echolocation (Whale Form Only)
traits.description: No blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

traits.name: Speak with Cetaceans
traits.description: Can communicate with dolphins porpoises and whales as if they shared a language.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Transforms into Huge frost giant Huge whale or back into its true whale-giant hybrid form. Its stats are the same in each form. Items worn/carried transform with it. Reverts on death.

bonusActions.name: Reel Anchor
bonusActions.description: Pulls on the chain connected to anchor returning it to its empty hand. If anchor is hooked around a creature creature: DC 19 Str save or be pulled up to 30' toward hvalfiskr.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hverhuldra can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The hverhuldra’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: create or destroy water, detect poison and disease, purify food and drink
1/day each: blindness/deafness, protection from poison

traits.name: Purify Water
traits.description: If the hverhuldra sits in a body of slow-flowing or standing water, such as a hot spring or a small creek, for at least 1 hour, the water becomes purified and rendered free of poison and disease. In slow-flowing water, this purification fades 1 hour after the hverhuldra leaves the water. In standing water, this purification lasts until a contaminant enters the water while the hverhuldra isn’t in it.

traits.name: Quick Rescue
traits.description: As a bonus action, the hverhuldra gives one willing creature within 60 feet of it the ability to breathe water for 1 minute.

traits.name: Water Protection
traits.description: While the hverhuldra submerged in water, it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. If it takes cold damage, this trait doesn’t function until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hverhuldra makes two steaming fist attacks.

actions.name: Steaming Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Scalding Stream
actions.description: The hverhuldra spits scalding water in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A blinded creature can make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Steam Cloud
reactions.description: When the hverhuldra takes cold damage, it uses the steam from the impact of the cold on its body to magically create a cloud of steam centered on a point it can see within 60 feet of it. This cloud works like the fog cloud spell, except the hverhuldra can dismiss it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: When the hydra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, its heads lose coordination. It is rattled until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: While the hydra has more than one head, it has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: For each head it has, the hydra can take one reaction per round, but not more than one per turn.

traits.name: Regenerating Heads
traits.description: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in one turn, one of its heads dies. If all of its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows 2 heads for each head that was killed since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn.

traits.name: Toxic Secretions
traits.description: Water within 1 mile of the hydras lair is poisoned. A creature other than the hydra that is immersed in the water or drinks the water makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 24 hours. On a success, the creature is immune to this poison for 24 hours.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When some of the hydras heads are asleep, others are awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hydra bites once with each of its heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

legendaryActions.name: The hydra can take 2 legendary actions
legendaryActions.description: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Rush
legendaryActions.description: The hydra moves or swims up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If this movement would pass through the space of creatures that are not incapacitated or prone, each creature makes a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature is knocked prone and the hydra can enter its space without treating it as difficult terrain. On a success, the hydra can't enter the creatures space, and the hydras movement ends. If this movement ends while the hydra is sharing a space with a creature, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Wrap
legendaryActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until this grappled ends. The hydra can grapple one creature for each of its heads. When one of the hydras heads is killed while it is grappling a creature, the creature that killed the head can choose one creature to free from the grapple.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: The hydra has five heads and is resistant to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and unconscious conditions.Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 HP for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge Special)
actions.description: The hydra exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 CON save, taking 40 (9d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. While the hydra has five or more heads, this action has a recharge of 6. The recharge range increases for each head the hydra has below five. For example, a hydra that starts its turn with two heads can recharge this feature on a 3, 4, 5, or 6.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Bloody Burst
bonusActions.description: The hydra squeezes the stumps of its severed heads, spraying blood and gore. Each creature within 5 feet of the hydra must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn and poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the hyena can use its bonus action to move half its Speed and make a second bite attack.

traits.name: Cackling Chorus
traits.description: If three or more hyenas are all within 30 feet of each other, their cackling, grunts, whoops, and yips create a deafening chorus. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of such a hyena must succeed on a DC 10 CON save or be deafened until the start of its next turn. The DC is equal to 8 plus the number of participating hyenas.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Cackling Chorus
traits.description: If three or more hyenas are all within 30 feet of each other, their cackling, grunts, whoops, and yips create a deafening chorus. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of such a hyena must succeed on a CON save or be deafened until the start of its next turn. The DC is equal to 8 plus the number of participating hyenas.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Warning Yip
bonusActions.description: The hyena can emit a brief yip at one friendly hyena or gnoll it can see within 30 feet of it, warning the target of danger. The next attack roll against the target before the start of the hyena's turn has disadvantage.

reactions.name: Rampage
reactions.description: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack. If it does, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
